## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link any related issue.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For training changes, include the model, data/configuration, hardware, and relevant metrics; distinguish a smoke test from a full experiment.

## Experiment compatibility

If defaults, data mixtures, or outputs change, explain the effect on existing experiments and update `docs/reproduction_notes.md` where appropriate.

- [ ] Followed the [contributing guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Preserved upstream attribution and avoided local paths, credentials, and generated data.
